spans.s:
रुवत् mfn. (-वन्-वन्ती-वत्) Crying, calling, howling.
 E. रु to cry, शतृ aff.

रुवथु m. (-थुः)
 1. Sound, noise.
 2. A cock.

रुवु m. (-वुः) The castor-oil tree, (Ricinus communis.)
 E. रु, उकक् aff.; or
रु to weep, कु aff., and the final vowel changed to उव; also with
कन् added रुवुक and with the first or second vowel made long,
रूवुक and रुवूक; also as differently derived, उरुवूक ।

रूवुक m. (-कः) The castor-oil tree, (Ricinus communis:) see रुवु; also
रूवूक, and रुवुक, &c.
